population: Owner-amended D1 set: the same 12 paired blocks and 36 sessions summarized in d1.json (12 sessions per arm).
status: Descriptive and post hoc. Not the preregistered comparison, which remains unidentified. Sanitized aggregates only; pending independent scientific and privacy review before publication.

definitions.session_elapsed_seconds: Supervisor monotonic elapsed seconds from immediately before agent subprocess launch through process exit and output-capture thread drainage. Includes startup, tool execution, provider/network waiting and capture overhead; excludes preparation, graph extraction/import, grading and gaps between sessions. Same boundary for all arms and replacements. The amended set uses 30 completed originals and six replacements; failed originals are not added to replacement durations.
definitions.session_elapsed_relative_change_nominal_: Retained analysis results over 12 amended paired blocks; dimensionless mean relative changes A/B - 1. A and B are named in comparison. Not intervals on raw ratios or seconds.
definitions.mean_session_cache_hit_share: Mean over the arm's 12 sessions of cached input tokens divided by total input tokens, from provider usage records; rounded to four decimals. Not the ratio of arm-mean cached input to arm-mean total input.
definitions.uncached_input: Total input tokens minus cached input tokens, per session.
definitions.model_calls_sum: Model calls recorded per session, summed over the arm's 12 sessions.
definitions.inspection_command_output_bytes_sum: Sum over each arm's 12 amended sessions of UTF-8 bytes in the entire captured aggregated_output of every completed command_execution event whose command text matches sed, rg, cat, head, find or ls at word boundaries. Repeated output, listings, failed-command diagnostics and mixed batches count, including test output in matching batches; no exit-code filter is applied. Unmatched commands, standalone test commands without a match, direct MCP responses and separate patch events are excluded. Private source_output_bytes maps to inspection_output_utf8_bytes. Not unique source bytes, files opened, reading effort or verified model-visible delivery. Replacements substitute for failed originals.
definitions.median_first_appearance_call_range: For each of the 7 tracked task functions, the median model call at which its name first appeared in non-index tool output; the range of those medians across functions.
definitions.approximate_carried_output_tokens_per_se: Post-hoc approximate ledger. Each session's cumulative input is decomposed into later input increases times the calls that resend them; increases are attributed to the producing actions in proportion to output size. Alignment fallbacks occur and one bundled native index output is over-attributed. Rounded to whole tokens. Not a causal decomposition.
definitions.paired_blocks_lower: Number of the 12 blocks in which the first arm's session value was strictly lower than the second arm's.
definitions.wall_time_paired_intervals_include_zero: All three nominal 95% t-intervals (11 degrees of freedom) for mean within-block relative change A/B - 1 in supervisor-measured agent-session elapsed seconds include zero. These are changes in ratios, not raw ratios or a speed-equivalence test.
definitions.sql_orient_sessions: Counts over the 12 amended sql_orient sessions: exactly one CLI SQL query each; that query joined g_edges to g_nodes once per endpoint (single hop); it used a keyword LIKE predicate; and it delivered rows to the model.
